scope: Begin same-file refresh with an explicitly authorized native Save for an already-dirty document

architecture.orchestration: refreshBegin.ts reuses LiveDocument and LiveRefresh with an expected process/revision guard

diagnostics.interpretation: Eight known UI template/include errors appeared when the UI module opened, before the dirty edit and Save; the same messages are present in earlier fixture reports. No warning was observed in the after snapshot. These findings do not establish an error-free map.

sourceTiming: After the native success run, only the handling of a confirmed Save with a UI reconciliation error was changed in refreshBegin.ts. This failure-path correction is covered by the focused regression and was not represented as a replayed native test.

refresh.scope: Existing component authoring generators, validated same-file publication and original native document reload
refresh.requires: Clean current Terrain document, no pending XML/inline buffers; explicit same_file_refresh workflow
refresh.recovery: Shared journal before close, internal rollback archive, preserved components and one-shot open marker
refresh.evidence: Native load/title and saved-file checks do not establish every component's model, rendering or gameplay
refresh.resources: Add, replace or remove Assets files in one guarded prepared group; 32 files, 64 MiB each, 128 MiB total source and original bytes

componentTransfer.tempRoot: Process-reported per-user physical staging store outside MSIX AppData redirection
componentTransfer.legacyDialogPaths: Bounded short paths shared by the packaged client and original Editor
componentTransfer.persistedUiBuffer: Native savepoint only after exact stable-archive byte equality; mismatched pending source is preserved

limitations: Already attached older MCP connections still require their own reload
Pending inline edits and unrelated native dialogs are preserved and block automatic Save
